recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a specific active profile receives an approved FMM-level change or if extension-pack ownership of the FMM extension requires scoped follow-up outside core.
issue_request: FHIR-11247 was Published/Persuasive and asked to add a maturity model for profiles. Its resolution explicitly says to use the resolution for FHIR-11245.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-11247, but Jira comments point to the FHIR-11245 SVN application. Imported December 2016 history includes 8bffa4f35aba636d69f24fbf71e9d57b5686b6bf adding profile/extension FMM/status template hooks and FMM/workgroup metadata handling.
additional_context: FHIR-11245's resolution supports FMM declarations in spreadsheet/XML-authored artifacts and exposing FMM levels on extensions and profiles that choose to declare them. Current profile/extension templates still carry the FMM/status metadata hooks, current versions.html documents FMM for all artifacts, and the canonical structuredefinition-fmm extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current core source edit is needed. Assigning new FMM levels to specific profiles would require separate artifact-specific approval and is not established by this Jira.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-11247 delegates to FHIR-11245's resolution, which defines the spreadsheet/XML FMM declaration and profile/extension registry exposure behavior.
